headline: Nvidia Shares Gain on Strong Forecast as Board Rules Out Huang Reinstatement
summary: Nvidia reported doubled quarterly revenue and issued a $130 billion forecast, beating expectations, while board chairman Harvey Jones confirmed the board does not intend to reinstate ousted CEO Jensen Huang.
why: Nvidia is the world's leading designer of graphics processors and AI accelerator chips, serving as a bellwether for global artificial intelligence infrastructure spending.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Nvidia's stock rose following revenue growth and a $130 billion quarterly forecast that beat market expectations.
